name: Pressurejaw Drop
introDiscord:
The seabed suddenly falls away beside a jawbone larger than a bridge.

Pressurejaw Eels twist through the teeth while the surrounding water
grows heavy enough to press sound flat.
introTwitch:
The seabed suddenly falls away beside a jawbone larger than a bridge.

Pressurejaw Eels twist through the teeth while the surrounding water
grows heavy enough to press sound flat.

pressurejaw-drop-approach.prompt:
Three descending paths curve around an enormous Leviathan jaw. Several
teeth disappear into darkness below.

left.message:
A calm pocket rests behind one tooth.

Shizuki wrote:

'Tooth taller than me.

Several times taller.

Refusing to imagine toothbrush.'
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative pool untouched and also refuse to imagine it.

right.message:
A Pressurejaw Eel twists through the gap between two teeth.

It has chosen the world's most intimidating fence.

forward.message:
A navigator's chest hangs from an old anchor line caught around the
jawbone.

pressurejaw-drop-depths.prompt: The Drop grows steeper as three paths descend along the jaw.

left.message:
A Berry rests inside Shizuki's abandoned measuring kit.

Her note reads:

'Attempted to measure tooth.

String ran out.

Used second string.

Second string ran out.

Scientific conclusion:

BIG.'

right.message:
A wrecked strongbox lies beneath a row of teeth.

Every tooth could comfortably crush the entire box.

Comforting.

forward.message:
A Pressurejaw Eel coils around one giant fang before striking from the
drop.

pressurejaw-drop-threshold.prompt: Compression Vault lies beneath the deepest section of the jaw.

left.message:
An Eel slips from a hollow tooth.

You discover that gigantic Leviathan teeth can apparently have cavities
large enough to contain predators.

Knowledge was a mistake.

right.message:
Mineral water collects beneath the jaw hinge.

Shizuki's label:

'Rest here.

DO NOT picture jaw closing.

I pictured it.

Now you pictured it.

Sorry.'
right.fullHpMessage:
You leave the water untouched.

You did picture it.

forward.message:
Star Candies glitter beneath a fractured tooth fragment.

The fragment itself is larger than most furniture.

boss-antechamber.name: Compression Vault
boss-antechamber.prompt: The pressure around Compression Vault suddenly doubles.

bossPromptDiscord:
The pressure around Compression Vault suddenly doubles.

A long shape coils through the enormous Leviathan jaw, weaving between
the teeth without touching them.

Use /yes to descend into Compression Vault or /no to return somewhere
with fewer giant mouths.
bossPromptTwitch:
The pressure around Compression Vault suddenly doubles.

A long shape coils through the enormous Leviathan jaw, weaving between
the teeth without touching them.

Use !yes to descend into Compression Vault or !no to return somewhere
with fewer giant mouths.
bossRetreatText:
You retreat uphill.

The jaw remains open.

Good.

boss.revealText:
A colossal Eel spirals upward through the pressure field.

Crushdepth Coil reveals itself!

completionText:
The Crushdepth Coil disappears beneath the jaw.

The path beyond follows the Leviathan's spine deeper into the Wake.
